title: Temperature sensors - critical high and critical low thresholds - are not defined in thermal_base.py
author: shyam77git
body:
Background/context:
---------------------
Per thermal-control-design.md, sec 2. Thermal device monitoring
There are actually 4 functions: 
get_high_threshold(), get_critical_high_threshold() 
get_low_threshold(), get_critical_low_threshold() 

Main point:
-----------
Each has a distinct threshold/trip point and should be tracked separately w.r.t:
identification, logging (syslog, alarms etc.) followed by unique action

Issue:
------
 The thermal control design doc states:
"If it above the high threshold or under the low threshold, alarm shall be raised."

codebase in https://github.com/Azure/sonic-platform-common/blob/master/sonic_platform_base/thermal_base.py has only following two definedw.r.t setting of thresholds:
def set_high_threshold(self, temperature): and  def set_low_threshold(self, temperature)

Expected Resolution:
---------------------
Add basic definition/functions for remaining two set functions (for critical high, critical low) in thermal_base.py:
set_critical_high_threshold() and set_critical_low_threshold()
